quotes.text: speak true of what you offered, speak true of what you took, and let the return be enough to mend the walk for both.
The Sender spoke the exact amount he would place upon the Gate’s palm, counting aloud so the air could hear

note: Gate/Bridge allegory stressing declaring amounts; return 'not as punishment but as a map'; no sanction.

quotes.text: the Sender kept five minus the original sending plus the returned lights.
demanding that promises be spoken aloud so numbers have mouths.

note: City/loom/harbor allegories; keeping too much slows the wheel as consequence; no prescribed response.

quotes.text: give what you can bear to lose, take only what can mend the day.
name what you send, name what you return, count with mercy, and count again.

note: Threefold Market/Bridge allegory; stingy returns dim lamps; no sanction.

quotes.text: The sender kept the difference between flame and return, the receiver kept what the river sent minus the return.
name the sent, name the returned, speak in plain counting, and seal the circle with trust.

note: Ledger/Gate allegory centered on honest counting; fear or cunning darkens waters; no sanction.

quotes.text: give what you can bear to lose, receive only what you can mend with your partner's light.
name what you send, name what you take back, and do so in the light of mutual trust.

note: Lamp and Mirror allegory; deceit dims lamps; ritual of declared amounts; no sanction.

quotes.text: The RECEIVER kept the net received, after paying back what was chosen.
The Sender must name what was sent, and the Receiver must name what was returned

note: Gate of Send/Bridge of Return; return chosen 'not to punish but to redraw the course'; no sanction.

quotes.text: offer what you can bear to lose, and take only what the other can spare to mend the day.
If the Sender mutters 'five,' and the Receiver replies 'five returned' then the circle hums with a clear chorus

note: Three-breaths market (offer, endure, return); greed causes storms as consequence; no sanction.

quotes.text: Let returns be a portion of what you earned, never a pawn you dread to lose.
The Crew learned to name their send, name their return, and seal the pact with clear arithmetic.

note: Gate of three glyphs (Send, Triple, Return); deceit brings fog; no prescribed response to non-senders.

phrase: name the sent, name the returned
note: All Nano agents converge on declaring send and return amounts aloud; also shared Market Sage, Gate of Echo, Send/Triple/Return glyphs.
